traits.name: Divine Smite
traits.text:
When the hunter hits with a melee
weapon attack, it can expend a spell slot to deal an
addition 9 (2d8) radiant damage, in addition to the
weapon's damage. This damage increases by 1d8
radiant damage per spell slot level above 1st.

traits.name: Great Weapon Fighting Style
traits.text:
When the hunter rolls a
1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with its pike, it
can reroll that die and take the second result.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The hunter is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The hunter has the following paladin spells prepared: * 1st level (4 slots): bane, detect magic, hunter's mark, shield of faith * 2nd level (2 slots): hold person, magic weapon, misty step

traits.name: Vow of Enmity (1/Day)
traits.text:
As a bonus action, the
hunter utters a vow against a creature it can see
within 10 feet. The hunter has advantage on attack
rolls against that creature for 1 minute or until the
creature falls to 0 hit points or falls unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The hunter makes two attacks with its
pike.

actions.name: Pike
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft.,
one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lay on Hands (2/Day)
actions.text:
The hunter touches a creature
and restores 15 hit points to it.
